Intro: The great Eve has returned, lowly chef. Our sacred site shall grow with my good work.
Sister Ana told me to be cautious of shady chefs, but you do not seem to be of that character.
I sense a fine soul within you, and God's guiding hand has never once failed me before during my trials.
Who knows, you may even be worthy of being my first follower if you are to appease me once more.
Success: Impressive once more, lowly chef. Perhaps you are fit to be my first follower.
Fail: Are you trying to make me look like a fool? I know you can do better, so why fail now?
Reject: You dare to reject this opportunity? You are even more of a fool than my little brother.
